facts.fact: The Public Service Regulations, 2016 (GNR.877), made by the Minister for the Public Service and Administration under section 41 of the Public Service Act, took effect on 1 August 2016 and are consolidated to 11 April 2019; the held text lists regulation 97, Minimum interoperability standards, in Chapter 6 but only as a table-of-contents entry, with the regulation's text not held.
